steps.text: Install a flat washer and nut on the push rod. Then bolts to 12-15 Ib-ft torque. Check to be sure there is at place tool J 3092-01 on the push rod, between the flat least .005 ” clearance between the cam follower legs washer and upper spring seat. Screw the nut down on the push rod until the spring is compressed sufficiently and the cam follower guide (Fig. 9). If there is insufficient clearance, loosen the guide bolts slightly to permit the retainer to be installed. Partially collapse and tap each corner of the guide with a brass rod the retainer and install it in the cylinder head groove. (Fig. 10). Then retighten the bolts to 12-15 lb-ft torque and recheck the clearance. 8. Remove the nut, flat washer and tool from the push rod.

Then screw (Cylinder Head Not Removed from Engine) the rocker arm clevis down on the push rod until the end of the push rod is flush with or above the inner l. Lubricate the cam follower as stated in Step 6 under side of the clevis. Install Cam Follower and Push Rod Assembly (Cylinder Head Removed from Engine).
